lessons.subtitle: Lesson 1 of 6 • The Sacred Sanctuary
lessons.arabic: إِنَّ أَوَّلَ بَيْتٍ وُضِعَ لِلنَّاسِ لَلَّذِي بِبَكَّةَ مُبَارَكًا
lessons.translit: Prophet Ibrahim (AS) left Hajar and Ismail with unwavering trust (Tawakkul) in Allah.
lessons.translation: "Indeed, the first House [of worship] established for mankind was that at Makkah." (Quran 3:96)

lessons.subtitle: Lesson 2 of 6 • Character Over Power
lessons.translit: Before prophethood was announced in the Valley of Makkah, the Prophet ﷺ was known as Al-Sadiq Al-Amin (The Truthful, The Trustworthy).
lessons.translation: "And indeed, you are of a great moral character." (Surah Al-Qalam 68:4)

lessons.subtitle: Lesson 3 of 6 • Patience Under Trial
lessons.translit: When faced with hardship in the hills of Makkah, the believers responded with Sabrun Jamil.
lessons.translation: "So be patient with gracious patience." (Surah Al-Ma'arij 70:5)

lessons.subtitle: Lesson 4 of 6 • Night of Serenity
lessons.translit: In the stillness of Mount Hira, revelation descended to transform hearts.
lessons.translation: "Peace it is until the emergence of dawn." (Surah Al-Qadr 97:5)

lessons.subtitle: Lesson 5 of 6 • Brotherhood & Mercy
lessons.translit: Spiritual growth flourishes when shared in a supportive circle of believers.

lessons.subtitle: Lesson 6 of 6 • Forgiveness at Victory
lessons.translit: When returning to the Valley of Makkah, mercy triumphed over vengeance.
lessons.translation: "No blame will there be upon you today." (Surah Yusuf 12:92)
